text_block_list.text:
I spot Rice Shower in the plaza holding
her head,
looking pained.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, B-Big Brother... Don't worry. It's
nothing...

text_block_list.text:
Oh, B-Big Sister... Don't worry. It's
nothing...

this
morning. But I don't think it's a cold
or anything.

text_block_list.text:

worry.
